claim: Google's 1.15 L/kWh WUE Category 2 figure should not be treated as contradictory to LBNL's much lower site-WUE values because the metrics likely measure different things.
displayValue: Google 1.15 is not directly comparable to LBNL site WUE
comparisonContext: This helps prevent one of the easiest chart and slide mistakes in this topic area: comparing unlike water metrics as if they are the same benchmark.
scopeNote: This is a methodological comparison of two cited metrics; the point is metric discipline rather than a single benchmark value.
sourceTitle: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report
